name: Lorekeeper Raintotem
summary: South of Red Rocks, Lorekeeper Raintotem tends Mulgore’s sacred burial grounds. He asks travelers to drive off Bristleback quilboar disturbing them.

sections.title: Watcher of Red Rocks
sections.body: Lorekeeper Raintotem tends his people’s sacred burial grounds near Red Rocks in Mulgore. Bristleback Interlopers disturb the resting place, and he asks travelers to drive them away so the ancestors may rest in peace.

sections.title: Defender of Ancestral Grounds
sections.body: Lorekeeper Raintotem watches over the burial sites at Red Rocks. Bristleback quilboar disturb the resting places of tauren chieftains and shamans. Raintotem calls on travelers to restore quiet and dignity to the grounds and their dead.

faq.q: Where can I find Lorekeeper Raintotem?
faq.answer: Find Lorekeeper Raintotem in northern Mulgore, just south of Red Rocks along the path toward the ancestral cliffs.

faq.q: Why does Raintotem seek help with the burial grounds?
faq.answer: Raintotem asks travelers to drive Bristleback Interlopers from Red Rocks, where they ravage the sacred tauren burial ground.

faq.q: Why does Raintotem need help at Red Rocks?
faq.answer: Red Rocks is a sacred tauren burial ground, and Bristleback quilboar are ravaging it. Raintotem asks capable travelers to restore the dishonored ancestral grounds.

angles.text: As a tauren, helping Raintotem defend Red Rocks honors your ancestors and preserves your people’s burial traditions.
As a shaman, helping Raintotem guard Red Rocks serves your duty to the restless dead, ensuring ancestral spirits receive peace and reverence.
